description: This PHP class defines the PaymentMethod model for the checkout process in an Opencart-based e-commerce system. It retrieves available payment methods by loading extensions, checking their statuses, and gathering their methods for presentation during checkout.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Model class responsible for retrieving available payment methods during the checkout process, by dynamically loading enabled extensions and aggregating their methods.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves an array of available payment methods based on the given payment address, by loading active payment extensions and calling their getMethods functions.
